subject: Platform architects webinar — reducing inference cost (Dec 9)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alexj@stacklytics.com>, DevOps Team <devops@stacklytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Platform architects webinar — reducing inference cost (Dec 9)

Alex / Stacklytics team —

Quick note from Redwood: we’re running a short (~45 min) technical webinar on Dec 9 focused on strategies platform engineering teams are using to reduce inference unit cost by 2–4x while keeping p99 latency tight. We’ll cover: kernel/quantization tradeoffs, batching strategies, smart KV cache patterns, and routing policies.

Who should join: platform architects, infra leads, and anyone owning inference SLAs.

If you’re interested I can reserve a pair of seats for your platform engineers and send a short one-pager + tracking links for your internal invite.

Attachments: webinar-one-pager.pdf (PDF)

Proposed next steps:
- Reply with names/emails of 1–3 engineers you want registered
- Or click the RSVP link: https://redwood.app/events/dec9-platform-architects?utm=stacklytics

Thanks — hope to see you there.

—
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Platform architects webinar — reducing inference cost (Dec 9)

Thanks Irene — that sounds useful. Could you add our infra lead, Samantha Lee (samantha.lee@acmecloud.com)? She owns our inference migration plan. Also curious if the session will cover multi-region routing patterns (we're evaluating cross-region fallbacks).

Also can you send the tracking links so our internal comms use the right UTM parameters?

Best,
Alex
